summary: Backend-only verification of the pivoted messaging/sync strategy: POST /api/li-search/message/script now performs on-the-fly URN lookup via voyagerSearchDashReusableTypeahead (type=MESSAGING_COMPOSE) with a FACETED_SEARCH fallback, and posts to both createMessage (new) and messaging/conversations?action=create (old). GET /api/li-search/browser-script returns Connection Sync v7 (DOM scrape + typeahead URN enrichment). POST /api/li-search/connections/push accepts entity_urn and upserts by public_id. Extended /app/backend/tests/test_message_script.py: added TestTypeaheadURNLookupScript (6), TestBrowserSyncScriptV7 (4), TestConnectionsPush (2). Ran pytest: 20/20 passed (1.51s).

minor.issue: recipient.name is stripped to [a-zA-Z\s] before typeahead — names with hyphens, accents or non-Latin chars (e.g. 'Zoë', 'Jean-Paul', Chinese/Arabic names) will be mangled and may fail to match.
FACETED_SEARCH fallback matches on first-name-only when public_id doesn't match (line 1399: rn.includes(fn) && fn.length > 1). Common first names will mis-target the wrong profile.
No server-side cap on recipients array length or message length — potential DoS surface.
Hardcoded fallback base URL 'https://qikberry-whatsapp.preview.emergentagent.com' at line 1522 — should raise instead of using a stale preview URL.

v7 sync does typeahead lookup sequentially with only a 500ms pause every 5 requests — for hundreds of connections this will be slow and could trip LinkedIn rate limits. Consider batched search or configurable throttle.
Silently skips connections missing public_id (no error surfaced) — response only returns 'stored' count, no skipped/failed breakdown.

critical_code_review_comments: Good pivot: on-the-fly URN lookup removes dependency on stale synced entity_urn values — resolves the 'No URN found' bug root cause.

Match logic is well-layered: (1) prefer public_id equality, (2) name substring match. But name normalization at line 1354 (strips non-ASCII letters) breaks international names — should keep Unicode letters or use full recipient.public_id for typeahead query.
Both messaging endpoints (createMessage + old conversations?action=create) are tried in sequence — solid resilience against LinkedIn API rotations.
Sync v7 correctly writes entity_urn back into scraped connections and reports urnCount vs total — enables partial success visibility.
The hardcoded fallback preview URL in get_browser_script (linkedin_search.py:1522) is fragile — should fail loudly or read only from env.
recipients_js embeds full recipient objects (including profile_url) into the client-side script; profile_url still isn't consumed by the lookup logic — dead field, minor bloat.

rca of the issue: Previous bug: 100% recipients skipped with 'No URN found' because (a) DOM-synced connections had entity_urn='' and (b) Voyager /connections API returned 0 hits due to outdated decorationId. Fix verified: generated script no longer depends on pre-stored URN — it queries voyagerSearchDashReusableTypeahead?type=MESSAGING_COMPOSE per recipient at send time and matches by publicIdentifier (deterministic) with name-substring as fallback. FACETED_SEARCH cluster search is a secondary fallback. Sync v7 additionally back-fills entity_urn during DOM scrape so future runs can skip the lookup step.
